from hashlib import sha1 as _timeline_sha1
import os, stat as _timeline_stat
_timeline_path = pathlib.Path.cwd() / 'scripts/ci_studio_timeline_cases.json'
def _timeline_read():
    def identity(info):
        return (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_mode, info.st_nlink,
                info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns, getattr(info, 'st_file_attributes', 0))
    before = _timeline_path.lstat()
    assert (_timeline_stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink == 1
            and not getattr(before, 'st_file_attributes', 0) & 0x400
            and before.st_size == 19559), 'Studio CI data is not the reviewed ordinary file'
    with _timeline_path.open('rb') as stream:
        assert identity(os.fstat(stream.fileno())) == identity(before)
        raw = stream.read(19560)
        assert identity(os.fstat(stream.fileno())) == identity(before)
    assert identity(_timeline_path.lstat()) == identity(before)
    return raw, identity(before)
_timeline_raw, _timeline_identity = _timeline_read()
assert len(_timeline_raw) == 19559
assert _timeline_sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(_timeline_raw)).encode('ascii') + b'\0' + _timeline_raw).hexdigest() == '09b75f9c3c7bd2238b8c8c5c64cadf4eee406636'
_timeline_data = json.loads(_timeline_raw)
assert set(_timeline_data) == {'schema', 'suites', 'native', 'native_script_git_blob'}
assert _timeline_data['schema'] == 'carr-studio-timeline-contracts/1'
assert _timeline_data['native_script_git_blob'] == '4d8d9eb52052200d98f4465ab1a99bb766adb866'
_timeline_cases = _timeline_data['suites']
assert {path: [value['count'], len(value['functions'])] for path, value in _timeline_cases.items()} == {"tests/studio/test_clip_preview_loop.py":[49,22],"tests/studio/test_project_markers.py":[48,13],"tests/studio/test_marker_consumers.py":[31,6],"tests/studio/test_clip_operations.py":[90,22],"tests/studio/test_clip_editing.py":[34,19],"tests/studio/test_clip_history_dialog.py":[50,27],"tests/studio/test_studio_controller.py":[18,10]}
assert all(set(value) == {'count', 'functions'} and type(value['count']) is int
           and isinstance(value['functions'], list)
           and all(isinstance(name, str) and name.startswith('test_') for name in value['functions'])
           and len(value['functions']) == len(set(value['functions'])) for value in _timeline_cases.values())
_timeline_native = _timeline_data['native']
assert set(_timeline_native) == set(["path","cli","installed_only","result_key","required_unique_checks","required_unique_count","required_origins","origin_count","source_checks_per_origin","required_fields","check_multiplicity","audio_runtime","limits","positive_paths","passive_loop_boundary","ownership"])

assert _timeline_native['path'] == 'scripts/windows_clip_editor_smoke.py'
